subject: general
question: A and R started walking from a same point. A walks 32 km towards north. R walks 28 km towards south. A turns right and walks 32 km. How far (in km) and in which direction is A now from the R?
solution:
According to the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db5628404737a299cdc5914637a125807cb6ee6ee555c9d984e7e07b2197c5a7.png] 

 

A is in North - East direction from R.

Distance = { sqrt{(32 + 28)²+(32)²} } = { sqrt{3600+1024} } = { sqrt{4624} } = 68 km

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 4**”.
